scenes.title: kali — your own lab VM only
scenes.narration: In your own practice lab, we scan a test machine. Nmap asks every common port if it's open, and which program is answering behind it.

scenes.title: SYN scan, step by step
scenes.narration: The scanner sends a SYN packet. If the server answers with SYN-ACK, the port is open. A good firewall simply drops packets to ports that should never be reachable.

scenes.title: Defence in depth
scenes.narration: Defence works in layers. Block what you don't need, patch what you run, require strong login, and watch the logs.
